title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
祭祀过程并没有持续太久。大约十分钟，将手中的稷米洒落在地上，这群自称竖沙部的异人站了起来，远远看向举父还有陆白所在的位置，纷纷露出震惊的目光。“启，你看到了吗，举父脾气这么暴躁的异兽肩膀上竟然站着一个人，难道他就是传说中的山神？”“笨蛋，他怎么可能是山神，我祖父说过崇吾山的山神是人首羊身。”“那他也一定很厉害，我还是第一次看到有人能站在举父肩膀上......”再次听到并且理解了这些部落人的对话，陆白确定了白泽精怪图确实自带翻译功能。不过。听这些人的意思，其实举父是个脾气很暴躁的异兽？？！陆白表情有些古怪地看了身旁昂着头，似乎很自豪的大个子一眼。随即跟着它一起来到这些竖沙部落族人的面前，接受来自他们的供奉。又或者说是过路费。这只出自竖沙部落的狩猎队千里迢迢，冒着巨大的风险而来，除了祭拜山神之外，主要的任务就是采摘一些崇吾山的特产——枳实。这种蕴藏着大量天地元气的灵果，食用之后增强食用者的身体素质，只是最基础的效果。最重要的是，可以让最有心无力的男性都能重新焕发第二春。一些血脉稀少、繁衍困难的部落或者异兽，都对这种灵果有着大量需求。“感情山海界里也存在不孕不育问题......”听完一位刚认识的竖沙部落小兄弟讲解后，陆白心生感慨。“陆白大哥，什么是不孕不育啊？！”刚才在人群里讨论陆白是不是崇吾山山神，名字为启的少年笑嘻嘻挤过来问道。“不孕不育就是男女结合之后，无法正常地繁衍血脉。”陆白看了一眼这个眉心有着蓝色菱形鳞片，身上带着几分机灵劲的黑发少年。经过刚才一番交流，他知道这小子跟旁边刚认识，绰号黑臀的小兄弟，是这个狩猎队里，除了队长洪之外，地位最高的两个人。他们俩一个是竖沙部落巫的孙子，一个竖沙部落首领的小儿子。两人都刚成年。这次跟着狩猎队出发，除了增长一番见识之外，主要是为了回祖地泰器山契约属于自己的异兽伙伴——文鳐鱼。这是竖沙部落每个族人从成年之后，就会相伴他们到老去或者战死的异兽。刚才狩猎队从河边搬运一些鱼兽尸体过来，作为供奉举父的肉食时，陆白看到了几只。那是一种白头红嘴，身上有苍色斑纹，明明是鱼，又有着鸟的翅膀的强大异兽。其中最大的那一只体长足足有三十几米，展开翅膀，跟一架波音737飞机差不多。陆白在看到后第一时间动用白泽精怪图，在花费了一百二十点愿力值后，成功拓印出了一个新的天赋能力。【控水lv1】顾名思义，得到这种能力之后，陆白从一个标准的旱鸭子变成了控水大师。

水流又或者空气中的水汽，能顺从他的心意变幻成任何形状。启还有黑臀这两个竖沙部少年，也正是因为感受到陆白身上散发出的这种熟悉气息，才跟他亲近起来。并且向他吐露了一些不是秘密的秘密。比如说他们的狩猎队除了崇吾山之外，还要顺着河流一路向西，经过长沙山、峚山、钟山，去采取那里的特产，最终才抵达他们的祖地泰器山。又比如说，他们竖沙部南边的邻居埻端国和玺?国，已经被西胡覆灭了，这是一个十分邪恶又强大的部落，舍弃对天帝的信仰，沦为了邪神的爪牙。又比如说，启有一个十分漂亮的姐姐，今年一百八十岁，才刚成年不久，启拍着胸口表示，他可以介绍自己姐姐给陆白大哥认识。“等等......”听到这里的陆白感觉有点不对劲，面色古怪地问道：“你姐姐今年一百八十岁，你和黑臀现在多大？”“我一百二十岁，刚成年，启比我大一岁，今年一百二十一岁，怎么了，陆白大哥？？”长得跟黑熊一样壮实的黑臀，满脸天真地问道。呃......你说怎么了，老子今年才二十！！陆白嘴角不自觉抽动了一下。......接下来的时间，陆白见识到了这群寿命平均是地球人类十倍的竖沙部落人，是有多么牲口。在得到举父的同意之后，他们一个个表现出远超美国队长的身体素质，徒手爬上几千米的陡峭悬崖，采摘生长在悬崖峭壁上的枳实果。即使不小心摔下来也没关系，狩猎队里面有人骑在文鳐鱼背上，随时准备接应。就这样十天过去。采集活动结束后。启和黑臀两个少年坐在其他族人的文鳐鱼伙伴身上，向新认识的大哥陆白依依不舍地挥手告别。“陆白大哥，我们一年后再来，听你讲猴哥的故事......”“好，你们快走吧。”陆白十分敷衍地点头。经过这些天的交流，他基本搞明白了为什么竖沙部，又或者说整个山海界的人族成年都那么晚了。除了他们本身寿命就很长，体内血脉需要时间慢慢激活这个原因之外。主要还是因为他们正处于刀耕火种的远古部落时期，每天的日常活动可能就是吃饭睡觉打豆豆，完全没有任何多余的精神娱乐活动。一个陆白随便改编的美猴王历险记，就让启和黑臀这两个少年惊呼‘从未听过如此好听的故事’。甚至那些已经成年的竖沙部落战士也经常凑过来，让陆白一度以为自己成为了说书先生。“不过......十天时间，也该回去看一看了......”远远看着狩猎队骑在文鳐鱼后背上，一头扎进了滚滚大河里，陆白转过身来，提着自己这些天收到的礼物，和举父打了个招呼，来到无人处消失。
content_en:
The sacrificial process did not last long.After about ten minutes, they spilled the millet in their hands on the ground. The group of strangers who called themselves the Shusha tribe stood up and looked at where Ju's father and Lu Bai were from a distance, and they all showed shock in their eyes."Qi, did you see that there is a person standing on the shoulders of such a violent beast like Ju's father? Could he be the legendary mountain god?" "Idiot, how could he be a mountain god? My grandfather said that the mountain god of Chongwu Mountain has the head of a human and the body of a goat." "Then he must be very powerful. This is the first time I have seen someone standing on the shoulders of Ju's father..." After hearing and understanding the conversation of these tribesmen again, Lu Bai confirmed that the Baize Monster Picture does have its own translation function.but.According to what these people mean, Jufu is actually a strange beast with a very bad temper??!Lu Bai looked at the big man next to him with a strange expression, his head held high and he seemed very proud.Then he followed it to the front of these Shusha tribesmen and accepted the offerings from them.Or tolls.This hunting team from the Shusha tribe traveled thousands of miles and took huge risks to come here. In addition to worshiping the mountain god, its main task was to pick some of Chongwu Mountain’s specialty products—Citrus aurantium.This kind of spiritual fruit contains a large amount of heaven and earth vitality. After consumption, it enhances the physical fitness of the eater, which is only the most basic effect.Most importantly, it can help even the most helpless men regain their second youth.Some tribes or exotic beasts with rare blood and difficulty in reproduction have a large demand for this kind of spiritual fruit."The problem of infertility also exists in the world of love, mountains and seas..." Lu Bai sighed with emotion after listening to the explanation of a young brother from the Shusha tribe he had just met."Brother Lu Bai, what is infertility?!" The young man named Qi, who was just discussing in the crowd whether Lu Bai worshiped the mountain god Wu Mountain, squeezed over and asked with a smile."Infertility means that after the union of a man and a woman, blood cannot reproduce normally." Lu Bai glanced at the black-haired boy with blue diamond-shaped scales between his eyebrows and a certain cleverness.After the exchange just now, he knew that this boy and the little brother next to him, nicknamed Black Butt, were the two people with the highest status in the hunting team, except for the captain Hong.One of them is the grandson of the shaman of the Shusha tribe, and the younger son of the leader of the Shusha tribe.Both have just come of age.This time I set off with the hunting team. In addition to gaining some knowledge, the main reason was to return to my ancestral land, Taiqi Mountain, and contract with my own exotic beast companion, the Manta Ray.This is a strange beast that will accompany every member of the Shusha Tribe until they grow old or die in battle.Just now, when the hunting team was carrying some carcasses of fish and beasts from the river as meat for his father, Lu Bai saw a few of them.It was a powerful alien beast with a white head, red beak, and pale markings on its body. It was obviously a fish and had the wings of a bird.The largest one is more than thirty meters long, with its wings spread out, almost like a Boeing 737 aircraft.Lu Bai immediately used the Bai Ze Spirit Diagram after seeing it. After spending 120 points of willpower, he successfully printed out a new talent ability.[Water Control Level 1] As the name suggests, after gaining this ability, Lu Bai changed from a standard landlubber to a master of water control.

The water flow or the water vapor in the air can change into any shape according to his wishes.The two boys from the Jusha tribe, Qi and Heihipu, became close to Lu Bai precisely because they felt the familiar aura exuding from him.And confided in him some secrets that were not secrets.For example, in addition to Chongwu Mountain, their hunting team also had to follow the river all the way west, passing through Changsha Mountain, Mishan Mountain, and Zhongshan Mountain to collect the special products there, and finally arrived at their ancestral home, Taiqi Mountain.For another example, their neighbors to the south of the Shusha tribe, the Yidian Kingdom and the Xi? Kingdom, have been destroyed by the Xihu. This is a very evil and powerful tribe that abandoned its belief in the Emperor of Heaven and became the minions of the evil god.For another example, Qi has a very beautiful sister who is 180 years old this year and has just reached adulthood. Qi patted his chest and said that he could introduce his sister to Brother Lu Bai."Wait..." Lu Bai felt something was wrong when he heard this, and asked with a weird look: "Your sister is one hundred and eighty years old this year. How old are you and Hei Butt now?" "I am one hundred and twenty years old, just an adult, Qi is one year older than me, and is one hundred and twenty one years old this year. What's wrong, brother Lu Bai??" Hei Butt, who was as strong as a black bear, asked innocently.Uh...what's wrong? I'm only twenty this year!!The corners of Lu Bai's mouth twitched unconsciously....In the following time, Lu Bai saw what beasts this group of Shuisha tribe people, whose lifespans on average are ten times longer than that of humans on Earth, were.After getting their father's permission, each of them showed physical fitness that far surpassed that of Captain America. They climbed thousands of meters of steep cliffs with bare hands and picked tangerine fruits growing on the cliffs.It doesn't matter if you accidentally fall down. Someone in the hunting team is riding on the back of the stingray, ready to respond at any time.Ten days passed like this.After the collection activity is over.The two young men, Qi and Black Hips, sat on the other tribe's ray fish companions and reluctantly waved goodbye to their newly acquainted eldest brother, Lu Bai."Brother Lu Bai, let's come back in a year to listen to you tell the story of Brother Monkey..." "Okay, you go quickly." Lu Bai nodded perfunctorily.After these days of communication, he basically understood why the Shusha tribe, or rather the entire human race in the Shanhai Realm, came of age so late.In addition to their long lifespan, the blood vessels in the body need time to slowly activate.The main reason is that they are in the ancient tribal period of slash-and-burn farming. Their daily activities may be eating, sleeping and playing beans, without any extra spiritual entertainment activities at all.Lu Bai's random adaptation of The Adventures of the Monkey King made the two teenagers Qi and Heihip exclaim, "I have never heard such a good story before."Even the adult warriors of the Shusha tribe often came over, making Lu Bai think he had become a storyteller."But...it's time to go back and take a look in ten days..." Seeing the hunting team riding on the back of the manta ray and diving into the rolling river from a distance, Lu Bai turned around, carrying the gifts he had received these days, said hello to his father, and disappeared in a deserted place.
